text: ASICS Corporation's site lists ASICS Japan Corporation (アシックスジャパン株式会社, headquartered at JP Tower, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo) among its group ('related') companies in Japan.
short: ASICS Japan Corporation is an ASICS Corporation group company.
